lines.start: {a} and {b} are lowered into the vat. They give a great deal of themselves and receive, in return, a shared and slightly baffled expression.
lines.decant: {child} is decanted. It has {sockets} working parts, {n} of which anybody planned.
lines.chaos: The vat improvised. {child} has arrived carrying {part}, which came from neither parent and is not currently accounted for.
lines.news: Rural veterinarian reports "an entirely new sound" coming from a barn. Declines to elaborate. Declines, in fact, to return.
lines.socket: {child} came out with a {slot} nobody installed. The vat has, in its own way, gone shopping.
